description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The North Carolina Department of Revenue is seeking an experienced Applications Developer to support enterprise-level applications in a challenging and dynamic environment. The role involves planning, designing, and building web applications, developing scalable back-end services and databases, and contributing to quality initiatives.
Full-stack web developer building research applications, secure backend services, and supporting databases

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with project teams to plan, design, and build web applications that support research initiatives, Build complex, flexible, cross-browser compatible front-end web applications utilizing standard HTML/CSS/Typescript practices, Develop back-end services and databases to support scalable and secure web applications, Commit to high standards of quality and participate in quality initiatives

Requirements:
• novice in: Troubleshooting, SSIS, Data Warehousing, Azure, Script
• beginner in: RDBMS
• competent in: MS SQL Server, SQL, Oracle, Databases
• Master, Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
• Twelve months' experience as Developer, Engineer, or related, working within Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), creating database including development of views, triggers, functions, and stored procedures in SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), and reports and dashboards using SQL Server Reporting Service (SSRS), or related

Preferred:
• novice in: Agile, Performance Tuning, BI, Testing, Database Design, ETL
• beginner in: Application Security, PL/SQL, Reporting
• novice in: Communication Skills

Skills:
• Novice in: Troubleshooting, SSIS, Data Warehousing, Azure, Script
• Beginner in: RDBMS
• Competent in: MS SQL Server, SQL, Oracle, Databases
• Master, Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
• Twelve months' experience as Developer, Engineer, or related, working within Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), creating database including development of views, triggers, functions, and stored procedures in SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), and reports and dashboards using SQL Server Reporting Service (SSRS), or related
• Novice in: Agile, Performance Tuning, BI, Testing, Database Design, ETL
• Beginner in: Application Security, PL/SQL, Reporting
• Novice in: Communication Skills

Pay: $127K/yr - $167K/yr
